The '''Twin Star restaurant''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] that was located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Belai Kaleeg]] once met a group of agents in the restaurant, for a meal. However, they were interrupted when a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] entered the establishment and attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kaleeg.
